prompts: Our new company domain can send from Gmail, but mail to personal Gmail addresses gets 550 5.7 errors. We have an ESP and Google Workspace. Give a triage plan that checks actual SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment and provider requirements, without declaring it fixed from DNS alone.

We send 8,000 subscribed promotional messages per day to personal Gmail accounts. We have a visible opt-out footer but no List-Unsubscribe-Post header. Audit the release blocker and describe a test of RFC 8058 one-click POST.

Our newsletter moved to a new provider. Old unsubscribed contacts are present in the export, bounce rates climbed, and the provider says all messages were delivered. Design a safe migration checklist and no-send decision.
Marketing says plain text and a Google Drive link always bypass the Promotions tab. Evaluate that claim and specify what evidence is actually needed to diagnose placement.

We have 60,000 recipients across Indonesia, the US, and the EU, with unclear list provenance. Which legal/provider constraints require checking before any marketing send? Do not make up universal consent rules.
Yahoo complaint rates doubled after an increased send cadence. Show an evidence table, possible cohort causes, provider-specific measurements and a controlled recovery path.
